craft_notes: Sthāyin: praise of chanters. Device: end-dash→comma (babbling softens onto hailing). Rejected: translating the mantra — killed: the Name stands unglossed, row 10. Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: Blessed Brahmā's brood, prattle past, who babble glad-drunk,
l4.sanskrit_cite: aho brahmādayo dhanyā ye vimuktānyasaṃkatham namo namaḥ śivāyeti japanty āhlādavihvalāḥ

reads_against.argmap: Ah, blessed Brahmā and others who dropped all other talk.; Mutter overwhelmed with joy: homage, homage to Śiva. → Blessed are those chanting Śiva, dropped all else.
c1_essence: Blessed chanters dropping all talk but Śiva's name.
reads_against.l2: Ah, lucky Brahmā and the rest — dropped all chatter, drunk with delight they mumble: Śiva, hail, hail.
l3: Blessed Brahmā's brood, prattle past, who babble glad-drunk —
reads_against.t1: Ah, blessed are Brahmā and others who, having dropped all other talk, mutter overwhelmed with joy 'homage, homage to Śiva'.
